decision.summary: The ignored runtime projection_delta court remains migration evidence only because it tests the old typed application runtime through inline params and legacy UI endpoints. The accepted replacement is a canonical Universal Cell court at the same relative path, proving revision-bound projection deltas over real Cell roots and no duplicate application truth.
accepted_canonical_behavior: application and canvas are compositions in one Uniform Cell store
visible wires resolve to real interface roots and incidence roots
interaction deltas are revision-bound and omit static graph/catalog/configuration data
topology deltas transmit graph-root patches instead of a copied application surface
duplicate projected graph identities are rejected before mutation
rejected_or_not_promoted: bulk copy from ignored runtime into canonical authority

commands.command: python -m pytest tests_replica\test_universal_application.py tests_replica\test_universal_interaction_server.py -q --timeout=180 -k "canvas_and_map_are_compositions or topology_delta or interaction_delta or scope or duplicate_projection"

python -m pytest tests_replica\test_universal_application.py tests_replica\test_universal_interaction_server.py tests_replica\test_universal_ui_interactions.py -q --timeout=180 -k "top_canvas_is_the_application_scope or exact_interface_migration or domain_public_interfaces or interaction_delta or topology_delta or duplicate_projected_graph_identity"
